info.title: q2 API
info.description: Kudos (q2) — shared self-care goals. Reference API for the initial version.

get.summary: Returns who you are, your streak, your badges and your recent activity.

put.summary: Changes your display name or your picture. Omitted properties keep their value.

get.summary: Returns somebody else's profile, with a balance covering only the goals you share.
Lists the goals whose current window covers today.

post.summary: Delivers a photograph into the goal's open window for its friends to vote on.
Asks for a person, a photograph or a challenge contribution to be looked at.
Creates an account and signs it in.
Signs in with an email address and a password.
Ends the session. Succeeds even when there was none.

delete.summary: Deletes the signed-in account and everything personal behind it. Asks for the password again.

get.summary: Returns who is signed in.
Lists goals, newest first.

post.summary: Creates a goal.

get.summary: Lists the goals that have stopped, most recently stopped first.
Returns one goal with its team and its resolved windows.

delete.summary: Deletes a stopped goal outright, for everybody on it.

post.summary: Sets a goal aside for whole days, with a reason its friends read.
Objects to a running pause, or takes the objection back. Anonymous.
Stops a goal for good and moves it to the archive.
Stores an image. The body is the raw file; its media type must be image/jpeg or image/png.

get.summary: Returns how much image storage you have used.
Returns the bytes of an image you are allowed to see.
The photographs waiting for your vote, newest first.
Returns one photograph, if it is yours to see.

post.summary: Confirms or doubts a photograph. One say per person, and it stands.
Adds or takes back a reaction. The same kind twice takes it back.

get.summary: Today's prompt and the room of your friends' contributions, or nothing if none is running.

post.summary: Contributes a photograph. A second one replaces the first.

delete.summary: Takes your contribution back. Your friends' are covered again afterwards.

post.summary: Adds or takes back a reaction. The same kind twice takes it back.

get.summary: Every challenge you have taken part in, newest first. Your own contributions only.
Lists what your friends have been up to, newest first.

post.summary: Gives kudos for an activity, or takes them back.

get.summary: Returns your friends, pending requests in both directions and suggestions.
Finds people by name or handle, with where you stand with each.

post.summary: Asks somebody to be friends.

delete.summary: Takes back a request you sent.

post.summary: Accepts a pending friend request.
Turns a pending friend request down.

delete.summary: Ends a friendship, for both people.

get.summary: The people you have blocked. Never the ones who blocked you.

post.summary: Blocks somebody and ends whatever connection there was. Blocking twice changes nothing.

delete.summary: Lifts a block you set. The friendship does not come back.

get.summary: Your invite code, created the first time you ask for it.

post.summary: Replaces your code, so a link that got out stops working.

get.summary: Whether this deployment sends notifications, and the key to subscribe with.

post.summary: Registers this browser, or brings its keys up to date.
Forgets this browser. Succeeds whether or not there was anything to forget.

get.summary: Lists your conversations, most recent first.

post.summary: Opens the conversation with somebody, creating it the first time.
Creates a group conversation with friends.
Leaves a group conversation.

get.summary: Returns one thread and marks it as read.

post.summary: Writes a message into a conversation.
Adds a reaction to a message, or takes it back.

get.summary: Returns the current preferences.

put.summary: Changes preferences. Omitted properties keep their value.
